name: Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company - Kansas City
old_description: Delta Fabricating designs and manufactures a variety of enclosures to protect your sophisticated electrical and electronic controls, instruments, and components from water, dust, dirt, oil and other environmental conditions. Delta Fabricating specializes in custom enclosures and panels to fit the needs of many industrial and commercial applications while providing quick delivery times.
about:
Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company was founded in 1952 by Bill Fox in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as a family-owned distributor of process motor controls and electrical components. The business has since grown into an international enterprise with offices in four states, including a Kansas City, Kansas location that serves as a regional hub.

The company distributes a vast inventory of electrical control components, solenoid valves, drives, switches, process motor controls, PLCs, HMIs, and explosion-proof parts from over 100 approved manufacturers. Beyond distribution, Lakeland provides engineering services, rents electrical test and power monitoring equipment, manages customer inventory to prevent supply-chain disruptions, and fabricates custom electrical enclosures through its Delta Fabricating division.

Lakeland serves industrial and commercial customers who rely on electrical controls, instrumentation, and component protection. Its clients include operations that need reliable component supply, custom enclosure solutions, and rental equipment for quality monitoring and power testing.

Since its founding, Lakeland has operated on the principle that customers should never have to choose between quality components, excellent service, and fast delivery. The company differentiates itself through its approved distributor status for more than 100 leading manufacturers, multi-location support across the Midwest and Mountain West, and an integrated service model that combines distribution, fabrication, rentals, and inventory management.
